scope: Sound-effect design and audio assets; game-runtime wiring is tracked separately.

style.unlock: First deliberate user gesture only; no sound during page load.
style.settlement: Play authoritative action sounds only after ACK/snapshot settlement; do not replay after reconnect or UI redraw.

entries.label: 漆木轻点
entries.trigger: 按钮、加减数值、页签切换
entries.prompt: A tiny rounded fingertip tap on a lacquered wooden tea tray, with a very soft felt-damped porcelain contact. A 0.12-second body and a tiny dry tail, comfortable when repeated. Entire sound fits within 0.5 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.

candidates.technicalWarning: Very quiet candidate; excluded from technical default.

entries.selectionBasis: 0.14 秒的单次圆润起音，频谱重心约 512Hz；适合反复点击，避开近乎静音的候选4。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 瓷盖确认
entries.trigger: 准备、确认预测、确认选王牌
entries.prompt: A tiny porcelain teacup lid settling neatly onto a cup, one soft wooden contact followed by a clean restrained ceramic ting. Quiet, confident, complete, with a 0.5-second decay. Entire sound fits within 0.8 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 保留瓷盖接触与短共鸣，高于6kHz的能量约1.7%，比候选4的10.3%更克制，和木质点击有区分。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 纸帘回落
entries.trigger: 关闭弹窗、返回、移除机器人
entries.prompt: A small parchment flap brushing back into place with a tiny rounded wooden stop. Soft downward paper motion, dry and restrained, no dramatic whoosh. Entire sound fits within 0.6 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.35秒、两段轻纸质动作，与立即确认的单次点击形成区别，同时不拖慢关窗反馈。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 入座茶客
entries.trigger: 本人首次进入大厅、好友加入
entries.prompt: A small bamboo curtain parting softly, followed by a single warm teacup being set on a felt-lined wooden tray. A welcoming intimate arrival, quiet and graceful. Entire sound fits within 1 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 先连续轻纹理、后约0.37秒落杯的两段结构，比单个瞬态更符合入座过程。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 茶灵入座
entries.trigger: 服务器确认添加机器人
entries.prompt: Two tiny hollow bamboo-wood ticks with a little playful porcelain clink at the end. Suggest a small helpful tea spirit taking its seat. Charming but restrained, no animal voice or electronic robot sound. Entire sound fits within 1 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.075和0.225秒的两个明确起音，避开其他候选的密集碎响，符合茶灵入座的短小反馈。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 纸牌轻展
entries.prompt: A short, controlled fan of thick textured paper cards being dealt gently onto a felt-covered lacquer table. Four light paper flutters in one compact gesture and a soft final landing. No aggressive shuffling. Entire sound fits within 1.2 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约1秒的多次纸牌起音，高于6kHz能量约8.9%，保留发牌节奏且比候选2/4更少高频压力。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 提牌轻响
entries.prompt: One textured paper card lifted slightly between two fingertips, a brief dry paper flex and a tiny soft surface release. Very delicate tactile selection, without an impact, suitable for frequent repeats. Entire sound fits within 0.5 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.17秒的单次动作，比默认候选1约0.49秒更适合连续换选；高频比例也从约50%降到约13%。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 落牌入局
entries.trigger: 权威快照确认玩家实际出牌
entries.prompt: One thick paper card sliding quickly a short distance and landing flat on a warm lacquered wooden table. Soft paper snap, rounded low wooden tap, immediate satisfying attack, no metallic sparkle. Entire sound fits within 0.7 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.41秒，前段滑动、后段落桌起音清楚，比候选2的多重碎响更像一次完整出牌。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 轮到你了
entries.trigger: 新进入本人的行动回合
entries.prompt: Two very gentle clear bamboo-and-jade chime taps, a lower tone then a slightly higher tone, like a small tea-room wind chime touched by hand. Brief informative notification, warm and calm, no melody or sustained ringing. Entire sound fits within 1 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 具有两次起音及清楚的共鸣带，与单次按钮/确认有区别；高于6kHz能量接近零，避免尖锐催促。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 王牌显形
entries.prompt: A soft silk-brush sweep with one delicate jade bell shimmer blooming briefly over a small porcelain resonance. Intimate restrained tea magic revealing a symbol, bright but not piercing, no cinematic rise. Entire sound fits within 1.4 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.74秒，高于6kHz能量约21%，明显低于其他候选70%–82%；保留短魔法共鸣。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 收墩小喜
entries.prompt: A small porcelain cup gently placed on a wooden tray followed by two tiny glassy tea-spoon tinkles rising slightly. Modest friendly success, quick and satisfying, not a victory fanfare. Entire sound fits within 1.1 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.65秒，落杯后有数次小共鸣；比候选1/4更有奖励辨识度，又比候选3更短。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 预测正中
entries.prompt: Three small rounded jade-and-porcelain chimes stepping upward with a soft bamboo click underneath, then a faint warm sparkling decay. Precise, graceful reward for a correct prediction. A short sound logo, not a musical passage. Entire sound fits within 1.8 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 保留三段起音和中频共鸣，高于6kHz能量约8%，避开其他候选约81%–100%的高频集中。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 卷轴结算
entries.prompt: A small parchment scroll unrolling smoothly across a tea table, ending in one gentle wooden seal stamp. Quiet papery texture, orderly and comfortable, no voice or cash-register sound. Entire sound fits within 1.2 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 完整卷轴纹理与结尾起音，高于6kHz能量约35%，是四者中较收敛的版本。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 茶会胜出
entries.trigger: 最终总榜本人第一名、并列第一
entries.prompt: A graceful compact celebration made from three warm jade-bell and porcelain strikes, a soft bamboo roll and a tiny silk flourish, resolving gently. Refined joyful enchanted teahouse victory, small room scale, no orchestra, melody, cymbal crash or grand cinematic impact. Entire sound fits within 2.8 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 保留较完整的低中频共鸣与2.76秒收尾；在四个候选中高频集中较低，再以高频搁架柔化亮度。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 茶局收束
entries.prompt: A brief soft pour of tea into a small porcelain cup, followed by the cup gently settling on a lacquer tray and a quiet rounded chime. Peaceful completion, dignified and encouraging, no sad trombone or loss buzzer. Entire sound fits within 2 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约1.52秒，前后两段明确，低中频为主且高于6kHz能量约0.3%，适合作为平静收局。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

entries.label: 轻声提醒
entries.trigger: 非法操作、表单校验、连接故障首次提示
entries.prompt: Two muted low wooden knocks on a padded tea tray, separated by a very short pause. Gentle corrective feedback, calm and non-punishing, dry and clear. No alarm, buzzer, harsh dissonance or startling transient. Entire sound fits within 0.6 seconds. For an enchanted Chinese teahouse game. One isolated close-up, warm tactile hit. No voice, music, ambience, beeps or harsh treble.
entries.selectionBasis: 约0.25秒内有两次明确低木敲，与普通单次点击有区别；避开候选1过低且接近次声的频谱重心。
entries.selectionReviewMethod: Per-candidate waveform, spectral distribution, duration, onset pattern, and role matching. This is an agent production choice, not a claim of direct auditory or human listening acceptance.

listeningReview: Pending human audition; no claim of subjective audio acceptance.
generationNotes: Official logged-in webpage used after connector tools returned unavailable. SFX v2, loop off, prompt influence 30%, prompt auto-optimization left on. Stored prompts are submitted text. Two overlength attempts produced no history or credit deduction. Downloads use MP3 where available; one source take is WAV. No account settings or subscriptions were changed.

limits: Device speaker and subjective listening not accepted
